note: Every purchase is either official (Credit Score debt, traced) or street (physical cash at a black-market markup, untraced). Credit is the leash the system uses to keep the lower classes compliant: fine for groceries and rent, ruinous for anything that matters on a job.

official.scrutinyNote: How much attention an official purchase draws. Higher = the system makes you pay for it in compliance.
official.override: An entry may set cost.scoreOverride to replace the formula (a number), or null to make it cash only. Overrides beat the rarity rule.
official.trace: Official purchases are logged against the character's identity.
official.blackMarketNote: The two rarest tiers never appear in official shops: street cash only.

cash.note: Street purchases cost the listed Cr price x3 to x10 in physical cash (GM decides by local contraband risk). No trace.

magazine.note: Decision 55: a spare magazine for a gun costs 10% of the gun (minimum 5 Cr). Every gun bought comes with 2. Reload uses one; the partly used one is discarded.

sell.note: Selling gives half the list price in cash; gear bought officially (registered) only a quarter — resale is allowed, but corporate planned obsolescence makes it worth little (decision 57). Street-bought units are sold first. Custom items: the player types the amount.
